decisions.reason: Its earlier quantified customer savings and strong fit with the core modular recycling offer put performance above aspiration, so with organisational slack there is little reason for problemistic search away from it.

As a flagship multi-model line aligned with the firm's strategic modular environmental-technology direction, management would tolerate some uncertainty and keep it unless results clearly fell below aspiration, which is not indicated.

This new 2024 shredder line is close to the established business and benefits from the firm's growth and slack, so despite limited proven results management would likely give it more time before reallocating resources.

The new spiral shaft screen line builds on existing capabilities and after-sales support, and in a growing innovative firm the absence of negative signals is more consistent with retention than with an early withdrawal.
